opening.argument: The material presents a local optometry and optical store offering ordinary eye-care services and designer frames, supported by two people shown in front of shelves displaying eyeglass frames. The promotion offers a free Starbucks gift card when a viewer books an eye exam for themselves or a family member, and directs interested viewers to click a link or call to get started. This is a commercial offer tied to a stated eye-care service, not an unexplained promise detached from the business being presented. The offer is described as available for only a limited number of gift cards, without specifying the number, while the underlying context remains an eyewear store promoting examinations and frames.
